convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'Arrows_Curves' custom indicator with 4 parameters, and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close logic encapsulated in BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator buffers must be understood to replicate signal logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds for signal time calculation
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime assignment in entry signal detection

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA operates

other_exits: Historical stop-channel scan: on new bar, if no direct close signal from SignalBar, the EA iterates backward through bars checking Arrows_Curves Buffer 2 (SellStop) and Buffer 3 (BuyStop) for stop-channel exit signals. A non-zero/non-EMPTY_VALUE in SellStop triggers SELL_Close; similarly BuyStop triggers BUY_Close. This is a retroactive stop-channel detection mechanism.
Opposing signal closes opposite position: Buy signal triggers SELL_Close (if SellPosClose=true), Sell signal triggers BUY_Close (if BuyPosClose=true).

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter is dual-purpose: negative values are treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values are treated as a fraction of deposit to risk per deal. The actual logic is encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a 4-buffer custom indicator (Arrows_Curves): Buffer 0=Sell signal, Buffer 1=Buy signal, Buffer 2=SellStop channel, Buffer 3=BuyStop channel. Signal is read at SignalBar index (default=1, previous closed bar). On each new bar, if no direct close signal exists, the EA performs a historical backward scan from SignalBar through all bars checking stop-channel buffers for exit signals. The SELL_Close and BUY_Close signals suppress the corresponding entry signals (lines 153-154). The Recount flag retries signal reading on CopyBuffer failure. Entry/exit permissions are gated by 4 boolean inputs (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose). Trade execution functions and CIsNewBar class are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The Arrows_Curves custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - its 4 buffers (Buy, Sell, SellStop, BuyStop) drive all signal logic. 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh encapsulates all order execution - the BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen signature includes MM (conditional sizing), StopLoss_, TakeProfit_ in points, and a signal time parameter. The position sizing dual-logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be implemented. 3) The historical backward scan for stop-channel exits (lines 119-151) is critical and unusual - it checks whether opposing stop-channel values existed in past bars to generate close signals. 4) SL/TP are in points (not pips) - no digit adjustment logic is visible in the EA itself but verify within TradeAlgorithms.mqh. 5) The CIsNewBar class and GlobalVariableDel_ function from TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be reimplemented. 6) Deviation parameter (10 points) is for slippage control during order execution.
